sources: OSM Overpass API – way centroids for all 21 building IDs
MCE NAAC 2023 laboratory records (provided GPS coordinates)
_meta.matching_method: GPS-to-model-coordinate transform + nearest OSM building centroid within tolerance

verification_legend.VERIFIED: Name supported by reliable MCE-sourced GPS within ≤20 m of OSM centroid
verification_legend.PARTIALLY_VERIFIED: Name sourced from OSM tags or MCE docs; spatial match is approximate
verification_legend.UNIDENTIFIED: No reliable name evidence – numbered placeholder used

milestone_summary.note: CS Labs GPS coordinates (13.022757,76.102653) land within 35m of OSM way 293811131 and within 20m of way 1211751384; MCE source says these are lab rooms, not necessarily building centroids. SA Block GPS (13.024190,76.103329) is within 14m of OSM way 293811133 centroid – strongest match.

buildings.source: MCE NAAC 2023 lab records – CS Lab I GPS (13.022757,76.102653) is ~30m from OSM centroid (13.0227752,76.1030254). CS Lab II (same GPS) and CS Lab IV (13.022835,76.102641) are nearby. GPS points likely represent lab room entrances within or adjacent to this building.
buildings.notes: OSM centroid to CS Lab I GPS: Δlat≈0.000005°≈0.55m, Δlon≈0.000275°≈29.8m → ~30m. Moderate confidence. GPS points may be interior rooms. OSM tag: building=yes, no name tag.
